_doc: POST /api/actions dispatch table for the Genome Atlas. Each action maps an action `type` (manifest.type) to a runner module + a schema_in manifest validator. Round-1 generic `import_table` is preserved alongside the 13 per-layer typed pipelines added 2026-05-20 (assembly_stats, chromosome_map, gene_track, repeat_track, te_hierarchy, conserved_elements, synteny_blocks, macrosynteny_orthologs, centromere_telomere, variant_annotations, synteny_oxford_grid, ortholog_tables, ortholog_pairs). Mirrors inversion-atlas/atlases/inversion/registries/data/actions.registry.json shape.

import_table.description: Read a tabular file (TSV/CSV/JSON) from the workspace and emit a staging_genome_table_v0 layer. Pure file-IO; no server engines invoked.

import_assembly_stats.description: Ingest a BUSCO+asmstats summary JSON for one haplotype. Emits assembly_stats_v1.

import_chromosome_map.description: Ingest a per-haplotype chromosome inventory (JSON or FAI). Emits chromosome_map_v1.

import_gene_track.description: Ingest a BRAKER / TOGA / RefSeq GFF3 (or pre-normalised JSON) gene track. Emits gene_track_v1.

import_repeat_track.description: Ingest a RepeatMasker / EDTA BED. Emits repeat_track_v1.

import_te_hierarchy.description: Ingest the per-haplotype TE alluvial JSON (Wicker 2007 hierarchy). Emits te_hierarchy_v1.

import_conserved_elements.description: Ingest a phastCons / UCE BED. Emits conserved_elements_v1.

import_synteny_blocks.description: Ingest a Cactus pairwise syntenic-blocks JSON. Emits synteny_blocks_v1.

import_macrosynteny_orthologs.description: Ingest an OrthoFinder / wfmash anchor-position JSON (gene anchors per species pair). Emits macrosynteny_orthologs_v1.

import_centromere_telomere.description: Ingest a tidk / centromics per-chrom centromere+telomere summary. Emits centromere_telomere_v1.

import_variant_annotations.description: Ingest a SnpEff / VEP impact tally per inversion candidate. Emits variant_annotations_v1.

import_synteny_oxford_grid.description: Ingest a macrosyntR Oxford-grid JSON (per ordered focal pair). Emits synteny_oxford_grid_v1.

import_ortholog_tables.description: Ingest an OrthoFinder focal-vs-non-focal summary JSON. Emits ortholog_tables_v1.

import_ortholog_pairs.description: Ingest an OrthoFinder per-pair gene-level table (lazy-loaded by page_orthologues View 3). Emits ortholog_pairs_v1.

edta_intact_ingest.description: Resolve an EDTA *.EDTA.intact.gff3 file from the workspace and emit a repeat_track_intact_v0 layer. Pure file-IO; the extractor handles the parse.

edta_all_te_ingest.description: Resolve an EDTA *.EDTA.TEanno.gff3(.gz) file from the workspace; the extractor streams it line-by-line and emits a te_hierarchy_v0 envelope of aggregated counts (per-feature rows are NOT materialized — file is too large).

edta_intact_bed_ingest.description: Resolve an EDTA `*.intact.bed` from the workspace and emit a repeat_track_intact_v0 layer. Companion to edta_intact_ingest; the BED form is more compact than the GFF3 and is what the Chapter 5 module ships.

kimura_distance_ingest.description: Resolve a RepeatMasker `.distance` (divsum) file from the workspace; the extractor parses per-divergence-bucket × per-family bp into a kimura_landscape_v0 envelope.

te_abundance_ingest.description: Resolve the long-format TE abundance TSV (Chapter 5 Fig 5.1 source) and emit a te_abundance_v0 envelope.

centromere_table_ingest.description: Resolve a quarTeT / centromics centromere TSV (Chr × {start_CE, end_CE, TRcoverage, TEcoverage, regionscore}) and emit a centromeres_table_v0 envelope.
